full_judgment: 2. The petitioner as plaintiff instituted a suit being Other Class Suit No. 87 of 1986, subsequently renumbered as OC suit No. 7 of 1992, for the cancellation of a deed of sale dated 4-1-1986 stating, inter alia, that 24 decimals of land recorded in plot No. 329 under SA Khatian No. 178 of Mouza Megha, PS Jamalpur is his homestead where he resides with his family. The plaintiff's case was that his daughter-in-law Hasna Begum alias Bokul having committed suicide, for reasons unknown, by taking poison on 14-9-1985, her father Hossain Ali filed a false case of murder implicating the plaintiff and others. Consequently, the plaintiff under compelling circumstances and financial strain, proposed to sell to Rafatullah Sarker, the defendant-opposite party No. 5 and father of the defendants-opposite party Nos. 1-4, a total of 51 decimals of land for a consideration of Taka 51,000. The plaintiff alleged that guided by ill-motive, Rafatullah in making four sale deeds in respect of 51 decimals of land also fraudulently and collusively created another false and fabricated sale deed in respect of 24 decimals of land constituting the suit land in the names of the defendants-opposite party Nos. 1-4. The plaintiff contended that he never, in fact, sold the suit land and never received any consideration for the same. It was also contended that the plaintiff having always been in possession of the suit land, and the defendants themselves having never gone into possession of the suit land at any time, there was no question of the collusive fraudulent and fabricated sale deed ever being acted upon. The plaintiff accordingly, sought for the said sale deed to be declared null and void.
